name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Father's Vengeance) — 2 Intermediate — Uriel's Disfavor

system.description: Win a Mental Challenge against your target to afflict her with extreme light sensitivity for the scene (extendable to the whole night for a Willpower Trait). She gains the Negative Mental Trait Oblivious near any light brighter than a candle, and suffers one level of aggravated damage per turn of direct exposure to bright light. Only affects Cainites.
system.duration: Rest of the scene, extendable to rest of the night
